name: gizza-ai/video-transcode
summary: Transcode a video to mp4 or webm.

tool.description: Transcode a video to a different format (mp4 or webm). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Quality 1-100 maps to ffmpeg CRF (default 75).

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

quality.description: Quality 1-100 (default 75). Lower = smaller file, lower quality.
